relics.name: Wick's Drawing
relics.lore: A crayon fish with too many legs. On the back, in a grown-up's handwriting: 'He draws them before they come.'

relics.name: The Keeper's Kettle
relics.lore: Dented tin, a rope handle. It has sat on a bare rock for twelve winters and it is warm. It is always nearly boiling.

relics.name: A Page of Isolde's Logbook
relics.lore: Tin-box damp, a careful hand. 'The fen hears. Sat at the post till four. It is not the fish that listen, it is what the fish are for. I have stopped saying her name out loud here.'

relics.name: Calloway's Tape Measure
relics.lore: Brass case, linen tape. It gave the same answer twice in a row, once, and she handed it over at once. 'I should rather not know which of us was right.'
